create or replace package body fiscal_calendar as
  function year_of(p_date in date) return number is
  begin
    return extract(year from p_date) + case when extract(month from p_date) >= 7 then 1 else 0 end;
  end year_of;

  function quarter_of(p_date in date) return number is
  begin
    -- Fiscal year starts July (Month 7).
    -- Q1: Jul, Aug, Sep (Months 7, 8, 9) -> Should map to Q1
    -- Q2: Oct, Nov, Dec (Months 10, 11, 12) -> Should map to Q2
    -- Q3: Jan, Feb, Mar (Months 1, 2, 3) -> Should map to Q3
    -- Q4: Apr, May, Jun (Months 4, 5, 6) -> Should map to Q4
    
    -- Standard calendar quarter calculation: (month - 1) / 3 + 1
    -- For fiscal year starting July (Month 7):
    -- If month >= 7 (Jul-Dec): Fiscal Quarter = ceil((month - 7 + 12) / 3)
    -- If month < 7 (Jan-Jun): Fiscal Quarter = ceil((month + 3) / 3)
    
    -- A simpler way: adjust month so July is month 1 of the fiscal year.
    -- If month >= 7, adjusted_month = month - 6. (Jul=1, Aug=2, ..., Dec=6)
    -- If month < 7, adjusted_month = month + 6. (Jan=7, Feb=8, ..., Jun=12)
    
    -- Then use standard quarter calculation on adjusted_month: ceil(adjusted_month / 3)
    
    if extract(month from p_date) >= 7 then
      -- Months 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 map to fiscal months 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
      -- Q1: 7, 8, 9 -> 1, 2, 3
      -- Q2: 10, 11, 12 -> 4, 5, 6
      return ceil((extract(month from p_date) - 6) / 3);
    else
      -- Months 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 map to fiscal months 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12
      -- Q3: 1, 2, 3 -> 7, 8, 9
      -- Q4: 4, 5, 6 -> 10, 11, 12
      return ceil((extract(month from p_date) + 5) / 3);
    end if;
  end quarter_of;
end fiscal_calendar;
